name: Army of Darkness Defense Vita
author: PiSCES
description: A port of the Android tower-defense game Army of Darkness Defense (Backflip Studios), version 1.1.1, to the PS Vita. It is a .so loader port: the original ARMv7 Android game library runs natively, with Vita-native graphics (vitaGL) and audio (FMOD Ex through OpenSL ES). Advertising, analytics and social-network services are removed, and the in-game coin store works offline without payment. No game data is included: a small offline preparation kit builds the data folder from the user's own copy of the Android game.
requirements:
- libshacccg.suprx
- kubridge.skprx
- Game Data Files: Android
